name: UI/UX Pro Max Skill
gives: A searchable design database: 190+ product types mapped to styles, landing patterns and palettes, 70+ font pairings, 100+ UX rules and per-framework guidance. Bundled here and searchable with search_design_db.

name: Awesome DESIGN.md
gives: 70+ DESIGN.md files that document real products' design systems (Linear, Stripe, Vercel...). Fetched live by get_brand_reference.
install: Copy a design-md/<brand>/DESIGN.md into your repo

name: Open Design
gives: A local design workspace for agents (prototypes, sites, decks) plus a craft library: typography, colour, accessibility, state coverage, anti-slop rules. Its craft rules are condensed into the foundation guides.

name: Taste Skill
gives: Art direction, references and a visual check in the browser: tells, type, colour, layout, copy and critique references. Condensed into anti-slop and the foundation guides.

name: Impeccable
gives: Rules and commands to spot AI-looking UI and fix it, with a detector engine. Its patterns power audit_ui and the workflow guide.

name: React Bits
gives: 215+ animated React components (text, backgrounds, effects). Searchable with find_components.

name: Skills for Designers and Engineers
gives: Emil Kowalski's skills for animation and small UI details: easing, durations, origin-aware motion, edge cases. Condensed into motion and native-feel.

name: Hallmark
gives: Deals one of 48 themes, picks from 21 page shapes and runs hard checks in a real browser so pages don't look machine-made. Its themes, shapes and gates shape pick_direction, layouts and review.

name: Google DESIGN.md
gives: One file that describes a whole design system for agents, with a linter. write_design_md emits it.

name: Magic UI
gives: Animated components and effects you copy into your app via shadcn. Searchable with find_components.

name: GSAP Skills
gives: Official GreenSock skills: core, timelines, ScrollTrigger, React and performance. Condensed into gsap-scroll.

name: Scroll World
gives: One skill that turns a brand into a 3D fly-through landing page scrubbed by scroll (needs paid video-generation credits and ffmpeg). Summarised in gsap-scroll.

name: Canvas UI
gives: 35 WebGL and WebGPU effects running over real, clickable HTML, installed through a shadcn registry. Searchable with find_components.

name: Dimensional Drawing
gives: Turns a UI component into an Apple-style technical drawing with paddings, gaps and radii. Summarised in dimensional-drawing.
